title: Overlapping Schwarz and stable subspace decompositions

items.title: Elementwise P1 product-cutoff energy estimate
items.statement: On a shape-regular affine simplex K, if theta and w are affine and I_K(theta w) is the nodal P1 interpolant of their product, then ||grad I_K(theta w)||_{L2(K)} <= C (||theta grad w||_{L2(K)} + ||w grad theta||_{L2(K)}), with C depending only on dimension and the shape-regularity bound.
items.strategy: Use vertex differences of the affine nodal product, affine scaling of barycentric gradients, and finite-dimensional L2 control of P1 nodal values.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Finite-dimensional Schwarz subspace-correction data
items.statement: Define one-level or two-level finite-dimensional Schwarz data using a finite ordered index set of full-rank prolongations, SPD local matrices, exact and inexact local solves, an additive preconditioner, and an ordered multiplicative sweep.
items.strategy: Specify global and local spaces, restrictions/prolongations, exact and inexact local solves, the coarse space, and the additive and multiplicative operators in exact arithmetic.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Schwarz local matrices and exact solves are well defined
items.statement: Every restricted local matrix is SPD and its exact local solve exists uniquely; if a coarse index is present, its Galerkin matrix is SPD.
items.strategy: Use the actual Galerkin coarse-projector supplier for i=0 and injectivity with the global energy for the remaining local matrices.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Stable two-level P1 decomposition for structured Poisson meshes
items.statement: On the stated nested uniform Freudenthal P1 meshes of (0,1)^d, d=2 or 3, with coarse diameter H and overlap radius h<=delta<=H/sqrt(d), every fine-grid function has a coarse-plus-local decomposition whose sum of squared Poisson energies is at most C_FE(1+(H/delta)^2) times its fine-grid energy. The constant is independent of mesh counts and overlap width.
items.strategy: Apply the boundary-preserving Scott-Zhang coarse map, construct a nonnegative bounded-overlap partition of unity with gradient O(delta^{-1}), interpolate each cutoff times the coarse residual, and sum the local energy bounds.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Exact Schwarz local corrections are energy-orthogonal projections
items.statement: Every exact local correction is an idempotent A-self-adjoint projection onto its local space and satisfies the energy Pythagorean identity.
items.strategy: Multiply the local restriction/prolongation formula and use the Galerkin supplier for the coarse space.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: The additive Schwarz inverse minimizes summed local energy
items.statement: When the local spaces span the global space, the additive preconditioner is SPD and its inverse energy is the minimum summed local energy among all local decompositions.
items.strategy: Assemble the local matrices block-diagonally, construct the unique feasible minimizer from B^{-1}x, and prove every other feasible vector adds a nonnegative nullspace energy.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Additive Schwarz condition bound from stable decomposition and synthesis
items.statement: If every x admits a decomposition with summed local energy at most C0||x||_A^2 and every local synthesis satisfies ||sum_i R_i z_i||_A^2<=C1 sum_i||z_i||_{A_i}^2, then lambda_min^A(BA)>=1/C0, lambda_max^A(BA)<=C1, and kappa_A(BA)<=C0 C1. If alpha A_i<=Atilde_i<=beta A_i for all local solvers, then kappa_A(Btilde A)<= (beta/alpha) C0 C1.
items.strategy: Use the energy projection identity for the lower Rayleigh bound, the synthesis inequality for the upper bound, and variational inverse comparison for uniformly spectrally equivalent local solvers.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Multiplicative Schwarz projection sweeps contract with explicit overlap constants
items.statement: Under a stable decomposition constant C0, additive upper bound C1, and a symmetric nonnegative local overlap matrix E with pairwise strengthened Cauchy-Schwarz constants and spectral norm rho, the exact coarse-first multiplicative sweep satisfies ||E_mult||_A^2<=1-1/(C0 K)<1, where K=1+2 C1+2(1+rho)^2. The product is ordered; no commutation of local projections is assumed.
items.strategy: Telescope exact energy decreases, compare additive projection energies to sweep corrections using the overlap matrix, and apply the stable lower Rayleigh bound.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Two-level overlapping P1 Poisson bounds with explicit H-overlap dependence
items.statement: For the structured two-level P1 Poisson family, the local-subdomain overlap counts give C1<=1+7^d and rho<=11^d; consequently kappa_A(BA)<=C_FE(1+(H/delta)^2)(1+7^d), and the multiplicative sweep contracts by the explicit factor obtained from the preceding theorem with C0=C_FE(1+(H/delta)^2), C1=1+7^d, and rho=11^d.
items.strategy: Count local supports per element and neighboring padded cubes, then substitute the resulting constants into the abstract additive and multiplicative theorems.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

title: Overlapping Schwarz and stable subspace decompositions — Examples

items.title: One-level point-patch Schwarz loses uniformity on 1D Poisson
items.statement: On the uniform N-interval Dirichlet P1 mesh of (0,1), the one-level exact point-patch additive Schwarz preconditioner has condition number (1+cos(pi/N))/(1-cos(pi/N)), which diverges as the number N-1 of overlapping nodal patches grows.
items.strategy: Diagonalize the Dirichlet tridiagonal stiffness matrix with its sine vectors and compute the exact local point-patch preconditioner.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: A one-node coarse space misses a high-conductance channel
items.statement: A bounded-size one-node coarse space with bounded-overlap exact local solves does not guarantee contrast-uniform condition numbers.
items.strategy: Give the two-by-two SPD graph diffusion matrix, compute its local solves and eigenvalues, and let alpha grow.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: The stable-splitting guarantee worsens as overlap shrinks
items.statement: For any admissible overlap radius delta, put r=H/delta to obtain the proved stable-decomposition upper bound C_FE(1+r^2); this formula grows along admissible families with delta/H tending to zero and does not assert actual condition-number divergence.
items.strategy: Substitute r=H/delta into the established one-sided bound and keep the implication direction explicit.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: A uniform two-level 1D Poisson correction bound
items.statement: On the uniform N=2M fine P1 Dirichlet grid, coarse P1 corrections at even nodes plus exact odd-node corrections have a stable decomposition constant C0<=2 and synthesis constant C1<=2, hence kappa_A(BA)<=4 for every M>=2.
items.strategy: Decompose each fine nodal vector into its even-node linear interpolant and odd-node residuals, then compare each energy exactly interval by interval.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)

items.title: Inexact local solves enter through spectral-equivalence constants
items.statement: For A=I_2 and coordinate subspaces, exact local solves have condition number 1; replacing the local matrices by diag(4,1/2) gives condition number 8 and satisfies the theorem's beta/alpha=16 bound.
items.strategy: Compute the exact diagonal additive preconditioner, its eigenvalues, and the uniform local spectral-equivalence interval.

references.title: Jinchao Xu, Iterative Methods by Space Decomposition and Subspace Correction, SIAM Review 34(4) (1992)
Peter Bastian, Lecture Notes on Parallel Solution of Large Sparse Linear Systems, University of Heidelberg (2015)
